name: Meest for WooCommerce
author: Meest

sections.description:
Meest is International Postal and Logistics Group, for detailed information – visit our website https://meest.com.

The “Meest for WooCommerce” plugin connects delivery from Meest to your online store, allows you to create invoices, courier calls and manage them.

Features:

  • Create parcels directly from WooCommerce orders
  • Manage courier pickups
  • Track parcels
  • Print declarations and stickers
  • Support for multiple delivery types (branch, poshtomat, address delivery)
  • Automatic email notifications with tracking numbers
  • Support for both Ukrainian and international deliveries
  • Integration with Meest API
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/meest-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the WooCommerce->Meest Settings screen to configure the plugin.
  4. Enter your Meest API credentials.
  5. Configure your sender information and delivery options.
sections.faq:
How do I get Meest API credentials?

You need to contact Meest and register for an API account. Visit https://meest.com for more information.

Which WooCommerce versions are supported?

The plugin is compatible with WooCommerce 3.6.4 and higher, tested up to WooCommerce 9.0.0.

Can I use this plugin for international deliveries?

Yes, the plugin supports both Ukrainian and international deliveries. For Ukraine, you can use branch, poshtomat, or address delivery. For other countries, address delivery is available.

How do I create a parcel from an order?

When viewing a WooCommerce order with Meest shipping selected, you’ll see a “Create Parcel” button. Click it to automatically create a parcel with the order information.

Can I track parcels?

Yes, you can track parcels directly from the plugin interface, and tracking numbers are automatically sent to customers via email.

  • Fixed: Updated text domain to use dashes instead of underscores
  • Fixed: Removed CDN dependencies, all assets now bundled locally
  • Improved: Better CSRF protection with nonce verification
  • Improved: Updated WooCommerce compatibility to 9.0.0
  • Improved: Code standards compliance improvements

1.0.5

  • Add authorization by token
  • Add address dictionary by DB
  • Fix bugs

1.0.0

  • Initial release
